social-cd30c5285baa.text: Trey Amos to IR-DFR wasn’t the frontrunner outcome in the public forum, and Quinn never suggested the possibility. All true. That said, Amos landed on IR in my final roster projection simply because he has played or practiced football for about 2-3 HOURS since fracturing his fibula in early November. Beyond the severity of the latest ankle injury, how long until Amos is in game shape? Allegretti practiced roughly the same amount of time in camp, but he was active in life/cleared for football the prior 8 months. CB was my main roster concern entering camp. Fallout from the Tunsil injury put the OL in pole position, but corner is right there until we know whether the pass rush is consistent enough to help hide them.
